claims.text: Under the Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940, a 'patent or proprietary medicine' in the Ayurvedic system refers to a statutory classification of formulations containing ingredients from specified authoritative books, rather than meaning that the product holds a patent.
claims.support_quote:
[(h)] ―patent or proprietary medicine‖ means,— 
 
(i)  in relation to Ayurvedic, Siddha or Unani Tibb systems of medicine all   formulations containing only 
such ingredients mentioned in the formulae described in the authoritative books of Ayurveda, Siddha or Unani 
Tibb systems of medicine specified in the First Sch edule, but do es not i nclude a medicine which is 
administered by p arenteral route and also a formulation included in t he authoritative books as specified in 
clause (a);

claims.text: To determine if the product fits this classification, are all of its constituent ingredients strictly mentioned in the formulae described in the authoritative books of Ayurveda specified in the First Schedule?
